jobs.description:
Overview

Graduate Planner

John Sisk & Son are looking for proactive, talented Planning Graduates across the United Kingdom
, including all regions to join our 2027 Early Careers Graduate Programme.  

The role

Our structured 27-month graduate programme is designed to give you hands-on experience across a wide range of construction projects, helping you build the career you want. If you’ve recently graduated or are about to graduate, with a degree in Planning, and you're ready to take charge of your future with a leading building contractor, we could be the perfect fit. This is your opportunity to make an impact and grow with us. 

Who We Are

Established in 1859, Sisk is proud to be in its fifth generation of family ownership. Our founding values of care, excellence, and integrity continue to shape everything we do. With a clear vision of Building Excellence, we consistently deliver high-quality projects that exceed client expectations. Our people are the driving force behind our success, and we’re now looking for the next generation of graduates to help us carry that legacy forward. 

A journey to your future

Our Graduate Programme is a carefully designed 27-month rotational journey that offers up to three business rotations across the UK, Ireland, and Europe, giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to shape your career path, fusing technical excellence, commercial acumen, and leadership capabilities. 

From day one, you'll follow a detailed development plan aligned to a clear timeline, ensuring you gain the experience and competencies required to pursue professional chartership. We’re committed to helping you build a strong technical foundation and excel in your chosen area of specialism. 

The programme blends structured learning, hands-on project work, and expert mentoring to deliver both depth and breadth of knowledge. With robust progress tracking, regular feedback, and a dedicated support network, you’ll be empowered to grow with confidence and make a meaningful impact. 

What We are looking For

A collaborative team player with fresh ideas, ready to challenge yourself, and us, every step of the way. With a passion for the built environment and a drive to make a difference, you’ll bring curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to technical excellence. 
Recently graduated or be on track to graduate with a Planning degree, ready to join Sisk’s Early Careers Graduate Programme in September 2027. Over 27 months, you’ll complete up to three rotations across the business gaining exposure to live projects, commercial operations, and technical delivery. 
Geographic mobility is  essential  - you’ll be expected to work across the UK, Ireland, and mainland Europe, including at least one rotation outside of your home jurisdiction. 

The selection process has been designed to ensure that we, as a company, select the right individuals that will thrive with us, but also that you, as a candidate, select the right company to build and shape your career with. 

In return, you will receive a competitive salary, a focused and structured start to your career and its progression in the construction industry, with excellent support and guidance every step of the way. 

If your application is successful, you will be required to participate in an online psychometric assessment. 

The programme will commence in September 2027.

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position, and we are open to hiring candidates from anywhere across the EMEA region.

About The Team

The Senior Consultant

The incumbent will work with new and existing customers and will provide expert guidance in integrating our product offerings so that our customers can start to experience the immediate value of Kinaxis solutions. Independently lead business requirements discovery sessions for implementations of advanced complexity, multi-phase workstreams and broad scope.
Partner with Solution Architect in the process design and technical direction of complex configurations.
Execute product configurations of advanced complexity, according to customer needs and approved solution architecture.
Act as the first level of escalation and oversee the troubleshooting and resolution of complex configuration issues for the project team.
Apply advanced mathematical models, optimization techniques and artificial intelligence algorithms to complex supply chain planning scenarios to improve customer supply chain performance and achieve business objectives.
Execute the validation and testing of the solution, capture user feedback and develop recommendations for escalations, roadblocks, and documentation.
Independently lead complex deployment workshops with a focus on training and guiding customers on how the solution was configured and how to achieve immediate value from their investment.
Provide technical leadership and recommendations to the Associate, Entry and Intermediate Solution Consultants during project milestones and critical deployment escalations.
Guide and mentor more junior consultants throughout the project lifecycle.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.
5 + years of in-depth experience in software implementation or deployment within the supply chain planning or supply chain execution space or business experience in supply planning, demand planning, inventory management, manufacturing.
2 to 3 years’ experience in a functional leadership capacity for system configuration or system deployments.
2 to 3 years’ experience in business process design for supply chain software implementations.
Passion for working in customer-facing roles and able to demonstrate strong interpersonal, communication facilitation and presentation skills.
Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills, able to synthesize a high volume of complex information to determine best course of action.
Self-starter who shows initiative in their work and learning and can excel in a fast-paced work environment.
Proven leadership skills within a team as well as a successful track record with customers and executive sponsors.
Ability to work in a collaborative matrixed environment with multiple team members.
Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Advanced level knowledge and hands-on application of supply chain best practices and concepts as it relates to forecasting, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), Constraint Management, and Production Scheduling.
Ability to lead complex business requirements gathering sessions with customers and system end users.
Experience working with supply chain processes and manufacturing planning solutions such as Maestro, SAP, Oracle or Blue Yonder applications to support supply chain activities.
Proficiency in SQL, R and/or Java Script.
Open to travel 50% on average and 75% occasionally and can work effectively when working remotely from client sites.

#Senior

Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands:
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Description

Mention Me pride ourselves in providing end-end acquisition solutions to our customers through our leading AI-powered referral marketing solution and our AI-first micro influencer solution.

Backed by Octopus Ventures and Eight Roads, we’ve raised $32 million in funding since 2018. Since 2013, our award-winning acquisition platform has driven over 9 million new customers, generating $3 billion in incremental revenue for our clients. There’s a good chance you’ve already come across us while online shopping from ASOS, PUMA, Gymshark, Charlotte Tilbury, or any other of the 500+ global brands we work with.

Becoming a Mentioneer means you’ll be joining a driven team, with big plans, at a genuinely exciting time for our business.

Role Overview

As a Senior Customer Success Manager
, you will own the post-sale relationship with our most valuable accounts; complex organisations with multi-stakeholder buying committees, and sophisticated technical environments. You will be the trusted advisor and executive sponsor these customers rely on to realise value, expand their use of the platform, and become champions of our product inside their organisations.

This role demands someone who is genuinely comfortable operating at the most senior levels of a large businesses. You will spend the majority of your time on-site with customers, building relationships across the levels of their business, challenging conventional thinking, and guiding organisations through significant changes in how they approach marketing, customer acquisition, and advocacy.

This is not a remote-first, reactive role. It requires presence, gravitas, and the ability to navigate the complexity and politics that come with managing relationships inside complex organisations. You must be willing and able to travel 30% or more of your time to customer locations across the UK and internationally.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Stakeholder Engagement

Build and own trusted relationships at C-suite and VP level across your portfolio, including CMOs, CEOs, CTOs, and their direct reports, ensuring you are seen as a strategic partner rather than a vendor contact.
Develop a deliberate executive engagement plan for each account, mapping influence, stakeholder mapping, and building relationships that exist independently of any single point of contact.
Lead and facilitate executive business reviews (EBRs) that speak the language of business outcomes, not product features. Connecting platform ROI to board-level priorities.
Be unafraid to challenge executive stakeholders constructively, pushing back on misaligned strategies and guiding large organisations out of their comfort zone when it serves their long-term success.

Navigating Large Enterprise Organisations

Chair and lead complex, multi-workstream programmes within accounts of different sizes, coordinating across CRM, Marketing, Customer Experience, Data, and IT teams simultaneously.
Navigate the internal politics, competing priorities, and slow decision-making cycles that characterise organisations in different industries, building coalitions of support and maintaining momentum through change.
Identify and develop internal champions at multiple levels of the organisation, ensuring adoption and advocacy is not reliant on a single sponsor.
Manage complex stakeholder matrices with diplomacy, patience, and strategic intent, knowing when to escalate, when to push, and when to listen.

Account Growth & Revenue

Own Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) targets for your portfolio of enterprise accounts.
Proactively identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including upsell, cross-sell, and new use cases.
Lead commercial negotiations for renewals and multi-year contract expansions, building a compelling business case grounded in demonstrated value.
Understand the procurement and budget cycles of businesses and plan your commercial engagement accordingly.

Value Realisation & Onboarding

Lead the onboarding of new enterprise customers, orchestrating cross-functional internal teams (Operationss Support, Product) to deliver fast, measurable time-to-value.
Co-develop tailored Success Plans with each customer that map platform capabilities to their specific strategic objectives, with clear milestones and measurable KPIs.
Act as a subject matter expert on the platform and its application to marketing, CRM, advocacy, and organic growth, guiding customers through the adoption lifecycle with authority and confidence.

Voice of the Customer

Represent the customer's perspective and interests internally, synthesising feedback from across your portfolio to influence product roadmap, pricing, and packaging decisions.
Develop referenceable customers and support Marketing with case studies, testimonials, event speakers, and community participation.
Collaborate with the marketing team to support client retention and advocacy initiatives, positioning your accounts as proof points for the platform's impact.

Requirements

Essential Experience

5+ years in a Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or Management Consulting role, with a minimum of 3 years working exclusively with strategic accounts.
Proven, demonstrable experience building and managing executive-level relationships (VP and above) within large, matrixed organisations, this is non-negotiable.
A track record of successfully navigating complex organisations of different sizes, industry and geography: managing multiple stakeholder groups, chairing cross-functional programmes, and sustaining engagement across long sales and success cycles.
Demonstrable history of retaining and growing revenue within a large portfolio, with clear examples of upsell and expansion driven through relationship-led strategy.
Background in Martech, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, or data-driven marketing technology strongly preferred; experience as a CRM or marketing practitioner is a significant advantage.
Comfortable with 30%+ travel to customer sites, predominantly UK with some international travel required.
Approaches AI as a practical tool for doing better work; whether that's faster research, sharper prep for client calls, or smarter prioritisation. Should use it to support reporting, analyse health signals and scale personalisation.

Skills & Competencies

Executive presence:
you are credible, composed, and confident engaging with senior stakeholders. They respect your perspective and value your counsel
Fearless challenger:
you are comfortable pushing back on C-suite stakeholders, guiding large organisations through uncomfortable change, and standing firm when it is in the customer's best interest. You are influential, credible and professional.
Enterprise navigator:
you understand how complex organisations work: the politics, the approval structures, the competing agendas. You find a way through, not around.
Commercially sharp:
you identify expansion signals early, build compelling business cases, and understand how to structure commercial conversations with enterprise procurement teams. You are data driven, metric savvy and effective forecasting.
Consultative and curious:
you ask the right questions, listen deeply, connect business challenges to platform solutions, and tailor your approach to each organisation's maturity and goals.
Data-driven:
you are comfortable using usage data, dashboards, and ROI analysis to substantiate your recommendations and build compelling narratives for renewal and expansion. You identify solutions to optimise processes to make decisions faster, with less risk.
Highly organised:
you manage a complex, high-value portfolio without dropping the ball, and you know when to delegate versus when to stay close.

We celebrate every Mentioneer, exactly as they are. We don't shy away from breaking down systemic discrimination in society, or from difficult conversations and decisions. We're committed to being a force for change. You can read more about how we're doing this by checking out our blogs here. The same goes for our recruitment. We welcome every application, regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic origin, physical ability, family structure, socioeconomic status, age, nationality or citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity.

Two Celebration Days; additional time off for you to celebrate religious days, cultural events, birthdays, anniversaries, or any other significant day that’s important to you

About MobiLoud

MobiLoud helps established ecommerce brands turn their existing websites into iOS and Android apps, without rebuilding their product or maintaining a second system.

Our customers use MobiLoud to drive repeat purchases, recover abandoned carts through push notifications, and reduce their dependence on paid acquisition.

We’re a bootstrapped, profitable, remote-first SaaS company founded in 2013. We’ve published 2,000+ apps and have hundreds of active customers today, including Estée Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji. Our team is 13 people, all remote and hands-on.

The role

You’ll be the main contact for about 30 to 50 established-brand accounts after launch and the onboarding handoff. We’ll measure your work by whether those merchants get more out of their app each quarter.

You report to the Customer Success Lead and work alongside them and one other customer success manager. The technical project manager and engineering team handle the technical work needed for the app growth plans you propose.

We’re responsible for the app, the push channel and the app growth plan. The merchant’s marketing team manages their email and SMS.

What you’ll do

• Plan how each merchant promotes the app at launch and gets existing customers to download it. Guide push opt-in flows and campaigns that encourage engagement and repeat purchases.
• Review performance with every account each month. Agree on a few concrete experiments for the next 30 days.
• Hold quarterly business reviews tied to the merchant’s app revenue targets.
• Identify opportunities to expand an account and handle those conversations. These include plan moves, add-ons, new integrations and new app functionality.
• Bring product feedback and requests for new functionality to the Customer Success Lead and engineering. Explain what the merchant needs and why.
• Keep account health, plan, expansion stage, renewal date and push performance current in the CRM.

Who you are

• You have three to six years in customer success, account management or strategy at an ecommerce-focused agency, a retention agency or B2B software serving ecommerce.
• You understand app growth after launch: getting downloads from the existing customer base, push opt-ins, and push campaigns around promotions, product drops and cart recovery.
• You’re comfortable with numbers. You can read a funnel, calculate the impact of a change and explain the results to a merchant.
• You can follow an analytics setup, look at tracking code and work with engineering on a fix.
• You understand the ecommerce marketing tools a merchant already uses and how the app fits with them.
• You write clearly in email, chat and documents. Most of the work happens there.
• You follow through on what you start.
• You speak and write English at a native or near-native level. You can meet during Eastern Time business hours for most meetings.

Why this role

• You’ll manage relationships with our largest accounts.
• You’ll help decide what goes into the customer success playbook.
• You decide what to test with your portfolio. You’ll have weekly meetings to review the work.
• Work remotely. We have no office.
• Set your own hours and take unlimited time off. Give notice when you’re out, that’s the only rule.

Not a fit if

• You’re not technical at all.
• You want a finished playbook handed to you.
• You expect a structured corporate environment. We work asynchronously with few processes.
• You want pure relationship work. Merchants judge your work by the results their apps produce.
• You need employee benefits such as healthcare, parental leave, or equity. This is a contractor engagement.
• You only want to work with one ecommerce platform. Our customers use several, and you’ll work across them.

How to apply

Apply through the form at https://www.mobiloud.com/jobs/cs-global/.

This is a remote contractor role, open globally with Eastern Time overlap.

Evaluate supplier documentation and compliance submissions against WFM program requirements.

Description

This position is an integral part of the Supply Chain Compliance (SCC) team, responsible for analyzing food safety and quality standards requirements and working closely with internal subject matter experts — including food safety, quality standards, legal, and other specialized teams — to ensure supplier compliance. The Compliance Analyst serves as the operational resource for suppliers navigating WFM’s compliance program, interpreting requirements, evaluating supplier documentation against standards, and guiding suppliers through the onboarding and approval process.

This role requires the ability to analyze regulatory and program requirements, assess supplier compliance status, and determine appropriate next steps within a complex, multi-step process spanning compliance approval, business compliance approval, and item setup. The Analyst communicates directly with suppliers via phone, email, and system notifications to explain requirements, provide guidance on software tools, troubleshoot issues, and resolve questions. Internally, this role collaborates with food safety, quality standards, legal, and merchandising teams to ensure compliance decisions are informed by the appropriate subject matter expertise and that supplier progress is communicated effectively.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with excellent communication abilities — someone who can work across multiple internal teams, synthesize complex compliance frameworks, and translate them into clear, actionable guidance for suppliers with varying levels of technical sophistication.

Key job responsibilities

Compliance Analysis & Standards Application

Analyze food safety and quality standards requirements and apply them to supplier-specific scenarios throughout the onboarding and compliance lifecycle.
Work closely with internal food safety, quality standards, legal, and other subject matter experts to ensure accurate interpretation and application of compliance requirements.
Evaluate supplier documentation and compliance submissions against WFM program requirements.
Identify compliance gaps and determine appropriate resolution paths, escalating to SMEs when specialized expertise is required.
Assess and troubleshoot complex compliance issues, recommending solutions of moderate scope and complexity.

SUPPLIER ENGAGEMENT & GUIDANCE

Serve as the operational point of contact for suppliers navigating WFM’s food safety and quality compliance program.
Communicate directly with suppliers to explain compliance requirements, answer questions, and provide step-by-step guidance through the onboarding process.
Translate complex compliance standards and software processes for non-technical audiences.
Proactively engage with suppliers to understand their objectives, anticipate issues, and ensure progress toward compliance milestones.
Send invitations and welcome new suppliers for FoodLogiQ and provide ongoing support throughout the process.

PROCESS MANAGEMENT & INTERNAL COLLABORATION

Oversee the supplier onboarding process end-to-end, from invite through compliance approval, business compliance approval, and item setup initiation.
Handle intake of new supplier and new item requests from merchandising teams.
Input supplier data into business compliance software applications to initiate downstream item systems setup.
Report progress daily and escalate non-responsive or non-compliant suppliers per established protocols.
Serve as the liaison between suppliers and internal WFM teams regarding supplier compliance status and progress.
Provide feedback on process improvements based on supplier interactions and recurring compliance issues.
Apply innovative solutions to enhance personal work and, where applicable, the work of the team.
